about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos and clips run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); story leaves the top bar and the reply field; square is the feed post and the best-nine image; wide is the landscape film for a screen, its margins the title-safe area of a 16:9 frame.
